sahneler.metin: A giant bridge collapsed into the St. Lawrence River while it was being built.
It was crushed by its own weight.
The span had been lengthened during design.
But the weight of the steel was never properly recalculated.
Workers saw a key steel chord bending more each day.
The order to stop came too late.
Canadian engineers still recall it in the Iron Ring ceremony.

aciklama:
Quebec Bridge collapsed into the St. Lawrence River during construction. The cause: buckling of an overloaded lower compression chord.
